dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: Oh, it is you again. Well met.

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: Do you know where there grows a big, pink, and very tall tree?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Wh—What?

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: It looks like the tree with pink petals next to the shrine, but it's very tall.

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: There are a lot of tingling, hair-raising things around that tree.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Tingly, hair-raising things... They should be Electro...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The tree you're referring to should be the Sakura Tree then...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Electro and Sakura Trees can be found everywhere in Inazuma...

choices.text: Is there anything else beside that tree?

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: Hibiki said that the tree is shaped like a fox. There is a very large "shrine" next to that tree.

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: Like the tree, it's very high up, and there are those tingly, hair-raising things beneath the shrine.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: A very tall Sakura Tree and shrine, and Electro...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: The Sacred Sakura at Grand Narukami Shrine.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, it feels like there is only one place in all of Inazuma that meets these three points. But...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Why are you looking for that tree?

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: Why, do you know where that tree is? Worthy of being my chosen one.

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: It is the place Hibiki mentioned. Hibiki said that she had stayed there for a while.

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: Also, she loved the petals floating down from that very, very big tree.

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: I thought about the reason why Hibiki hasn't returned until now. Could it be because she is doing something somewhere?

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: Since Hibiki isn't coming back for the time being, I will go and look for her.

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: It seems that you know where the tree is. Please take me there.

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: The stone human will take care of the shrine for me. There is no need to worry.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Paimon never thought that {NICKNAME} would say this one day...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Thank you for your effort, Mr. Ooshima. Okay, time to head off.

choices.text: We'll leave it to him, then.
Is there something special about that tree?

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: Hmm... The scent of a human, and a familiar one, too...

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: Huh, so it wasn't Hibiki after all.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: A talking cat?

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: Hmph. Such a fuss you make, human.

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: Of course cats can speak. It is simply that human ears cannot comprehend them.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Who's Hibiki?

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: Hibiki is Hibiki. She came from this shrine.

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: A long, long... long, long time ago, after a huge thunderstorm, Hibiki never returned... and there was no one to help brush my fur thereafter.

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: Until Hibiki returns, I will care for the shrine, and will brush my own fur, meow meow.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you, then...

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: Meow meow... It has been long since I spoke human language. It is such a tiring endeavor...

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: The shrine looks better and better, and my fur has also grown supple, meow meow.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, about the shrine...

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: Thanks to your help, the shrine is regaining its former self. Hibiki will surely be pleased when she returns.

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: Still, I have discovered something strange...

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: On a stroll, I discovered that the surrounding villages have not a soul within them...

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: Meow meow... How strange, where did all those humans go?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How have the people at the shrine been doing?

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: I can see that they are all good folk. They have put much Mora in the Offering Box.

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: The green human is always frowning, always muttering, always worried about... disappointing some guild or another...

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: The green, taller human is... Ohh, he is most terrifying. He knows too much about the weaknesses of cats, meow meow...

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: That knock-knocking human seems very concerned about his... salary, but he is a noble, loyal soul. He has even made wooden cats.

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: They are all good people. Hibiki will surely become friends with them when she returns. Meow, meow...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you.

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: Goodbye, meow meow.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The Warding Stones have been sealed.

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: Have they indeed? Most swift of you.

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: This way, my hair shall never again stand on end or be warped into furballs.

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: Excellent, excellent. Meow, meow.
